summary: Elme Communities filed an 8-K updating ongoing liquidation activities under a Plan of Sale and Liquidation approved by shareholders on October 30, 2025. The Trust sold five of ten remaining properties and entered into purchase agreements for four more, expecting aggregate gross proceeds of ~$431.3 million. This follows a 19-asset portfolio sale to Cortland Partners, LLC on November 12, 2025. The update revises estimated additional liquidating distributions after costs, debt repayment ($520M term loan), and reserves. Wind-down continues toward dissolution. Watch for final property sales, distribution timing, and debt extinguishment updates.
